entries.name: GitHub
entries.purpose: Links tasks to GitHub issues; agents open PRs with `gh`.
entries.enable: Answer yes to the GitHub workflows question in `npm run setup`, install `gh` and run `gh auth login`.

entries.name: Telegram relay
entries.purpose: Relays messages between your agents and a Telegram group.
entries.enable: Answer yes to the remote team and Telegram questions in `npm run setup`, then run `npm run relay`.

entries.name: Graphify
entries.purpose: Builds a navigable graph of your codebase for the agents.
entries.enable: Buy the Graph add-on, run `npm run setup`, then `npm run graph:generate <project>`.

entries.name: Claude Code

entries.name: Cursor
entries.enable: Included. Open the hub folder in Cursor.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot
entries.enable: Included. Open the hub folder in VS Code with GitHub Copilot.

entries.enable: Included. Open the hub folder in Codex.

entries.name: Agents
entries.purpose: Architect, Builder, Tester and Router work as a team.

entries.name: Memory
entries.purpose: Agent memory and tasks that persist across sessions: files in your repo on Free, a vault on Sub and Ops.

entries.name: Codebase graph
entries.purpose: A navigable graph of your codebase for the agents.
entries.enable: Buy the Graph add-on, run `npm run setup`, then `npm run graph:generate <project>`.

entries.name: Hub error reports
entries.purpose: Sends hub tool errors to Agistra, never your code or files; 90-day trial on Free.
entries.enable: `npm run setup` asks once; off unless you say yes.
